name: KIMLUN
recent: Kimlun 与 Astaka Padu 合作在柔佛新山开发价值 RM450 million 的服务式公寓项目，并签署补充认购与股东协议。公司将于 2026 年 12 月 10 日召开特别股东大会，寻求批准向联营公司 Astaka Kimlun 提供财务援助。最新季度营收环比增长 20.9%，净利环比增长 99.0%。
notable: 与 Astaka Padu 合作开发价值 RM450 million 的柔佛新山服务式公寓项目。
签署补充认购与股东协议，修订与 Astaka Kimlun 及 Astaka Capital 的原有协议。
将提交特别股东大会批准。
risks: 执行主席 Pang Tin @ Pang Yon Tin 于 2026 年 9 月 8 日和 10 日合计增持 6,080,000 股。
执行董事 Sim Tian Liang 于 2026 年 9 月 10 日增持 150,000 股。
公司此前进行私募配售，最新季度更新涉及配售所得款项使用情况。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 MYR 513.715 million，环比增长 20.9%，同比增长 18.9%；净利为 MYR 22.388 million，环比增长 99.0%，但同比下降 5.3%；净利率为 4.4%，高于上一季度的 2.6%。

recent_en: Kimlun is partnering with Astaka Padu to develop a RM450 million serviced residence project in Johor Bahru and has entered into a supplemental subscription and shareholders' agreement. Latest quarter revenue rose 20.9% QoQ and net income jumped 99.0% QoQ.
notable_en: Partnering with Astaka Padu to develop a RM450 million serviced residence project in Johor Bahru.
Entered into a supplemental subscription and shareholders' agreement to amend and restate the original agreement with Astaka Kimlun and Astaka Capital.
Proposes to provide financial assistance to 49%-owned associate Astaka Kimlun, subject to EGM approval.
risks_en: Executive Chairman Pang Tin @ Pang Yon Tin acquired a total of 6,080,000 shares on 8 and 10 September 2026.
Executive Director Sim Tian Liang acquired 150,000 shares on 10 September 2026.
The company previously undertook a private placement, with the latest quarterly update on proceeds utilisation.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 513.715 million, up 20.9% QoQ and 18.9% YoY; net income was MYR 22.388 million, up 99.0% QoQ but down 5.3% YoY; net margin was 4.4%, higher than 2.6% in the previous quarter.
